overview: TradeNest Naturals is an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter delivering premium Shatavari Powder directly from India. Processed from selected roots using controlled drying and fine milling, this ingredient offers dependable quality across industrial applications. Every batch passes through a meticulous six-step production sequence to guarantee exceptional consistency, purity, and flowability for demanding global commercial buyers.

Our fine-milled botanical powder features an 80 to 100 mesh profile with moisture maintained at or below 7 percent. We supply flexible bulk orders starting from 5 kg alongside custom OEM and private label packaging solutions. Complete export documentation support and prompt sample dispatches ensure seamless supply chain integration for manufacturers, distributors, and processing facilities worldwide.
highlights: Fine-milled particle profile of 80 to 100 mesh
Moisture content strictly maintained at or below 7%
Manufactured through a disciplined six-step process
Shelf life stability of up to 24 months
Pure botanical origin with no additives
applications: Herbal tea blends and botanical infusions
packaging: 25 kg multi-wall paper bags with inner liner
Small private-label retail pouches and jars

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for Shatavari Powder?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity starts at 5 kg, catering to trial orders as well as large-scale bulk procurement.
We follow a 6-step process comprising sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing with dispatch.

faqs.q: Do you provide OEM and private label services?
faqs.a: Yes, we support OEM and private label packaging, including custom particle mesh sizes and retail-ready pouches or jars.

faqs.q: Can international buyers request product samples?
faqs.a: Yes, product samples are available upon request to assist commercial buyers with evaluation and testing prior to bulk ordering.

faqs.q: What export compliance support do you provide?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter and FSSAI-licensed manufacturer, we provide complete export documentation support for seamless international shipments.

faqs.q: What are the recommended storage conditions?
faqs.a: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture to maintain product stability across its 24-month shelf life.
